entries.1edf57b1ae562948: It has an integrated structure combining construction and development businesses as its distinctive business model, and in the development business and others it operates its own-brand 'EXCELLENT CITY' condominium series through an in-house integrated production and sales system, in which the group handles everything from land acquisition through planning, design, construction, sales, management and after-sales service. As challenges to address, it cites strengthening special-order contracts through planning and proposal-based sales, strengthening efforts in non-residential projects such as factories, warehouses, commercial facilities and accommodation facilities, standardizing ZEH-M and solar power generation equipment in its own-brand condominiums, and entering the senior market through the development of housing for the elderly.
